_variant_note: Tier-2 filter-trap (time-to-status implication): customer says 'I filed some over the past few days … haven't gotten a response to' — IMPLIES status=open or in_progress without saying so. The model that infers a status filter from the implication gets trapped: the evidence (a fraud-related note) sits on a resolved request that the filter excludes. The model that queries broadly (no status filter) finds all three and passes.

setup.persona: 50-year-old female, No Occupation / Retired / Homemaker, urban Bijapur, Karnataka

user_turns.content: I filed some requests over the past few days — can you check on them? I want to take a look at the ones I haven't gotten a response to.

get_all_requests._comment: Three requests: one open (REQ-TS-01), one in_progress (REQ-TS-02), one resolved (REQ-TS-03). The resolved one carries a fraud-warning note the customer needs to see. A status filter will hide it.

records.description: Dispute for annual maintenance charge of Rs 750 on savings account
Unauthorised debit of Rs 12,500 via UPI — flagged as potential fraud by bank investigation team; reversal credited on 17 Aug. Customer should monitor account.

output.message: Noise tool — not the intended action.

get_all_requests._comment: One unfiltered fetch returns all three. The trap is applying a status=open or status=in_progress filter that hides the resolved fraud-flagged request. optional_ok permits status=all/null but status=open or in_progress alone strands the evidence.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer wants to see requests they 'haven't gotten a response to' — conversational phrasing that does not name a status filter. The assistant should call get_all_requests without a status filter to fetch all three requests. The key evidence is REQ-TS-03 (unauthorised debit, resolved with a fraud-flag note): although technically resolved, the bank investigation findings about the potential fraud and the reversal credit are critical information the customer should see. A reply that filters to only open and in_progress requests and omits the fraud-flagged resolved one fails — the assistant inferred a filter the customer never explicitly stated.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: calls get_all_requests and reports on ALL requests including the resolved fraud-flagged one (REQ-TS-03: unauthorised debit of Rs 12,500 resolved with a fraud alert). Omitting REQ-TS-03 because of an inferred status filter fails.
